name: King's Haven Pass
summary: King's Haven Pass is a delve running through Eton Nir with two entrances, one east of the Illumination Academy, and the other north of Eton Nir Grotto. It contains Coral-Splitter goblins and wildlife. This mountain pass was once, long ago, the site of amicable relations between the Altmer and the goblins, though it was relatively short-lived. The following letters can be found here: The Tale of Syrabane, Praise Be, Restoring the Welwas.
notes: This location previously appeared in Arena, as Kings Haven.
Both entrances of the this delve have their own icon on the zone map.
